{
  "name": "wirepane",
  "displayName": "Wirepane",
  "version": "0.9.2",
  "description": "The debugging proxy Claude can read, inside Claude Code on macOS: HTTPS, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets and server-sent events from the browser, iOS and Android; one-press device setup; rules and mock servers; a doctor that fixes what is in the way; 16 tools and 3 skills for Claude.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Legostin Vyacheslav",
    "url": "https://github.com/legostin"
  },
  "homepage": "https://legostin.github.io/wirepane/",
  "repository": "https://github.com/legostin/wirepane",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "android",
    "charles-alternative",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "debugging",
    "grpc",
    "har",
    "http-toolkit-alternative",
    "http2",
    "https-proxy",
    "ios",
    "mitm",
    "mitmproxy-alternative",
    "mock-server",
    "network",
    "proxy",
    "proxyman-alternative",
    "rewrite-rules",
    "server-sent-events",
    "websocket"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "port": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Proxy port",
      "description": "The port the proxy listens on.",
      "default": 8899
    },
    "listen": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Proxy reachable from",
      "description": "local: this Mac only (browser, simulators, Android emulator). lan: also phones on the same network.",
      "options": [
        "local",
        "lan"
      ],
      "default": "local"
    },
    "noDecrypt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hosts never decrypted",
      "description": "Comma-separated hosts tunnelled untouched (pinned services); *.example.com covers subdomains. Hosts that refuse the certificate twice are passed through on their own.",
      "default": "*.apple.com,*.icloud.com,*.mzstatic.com,*.apple-cloudkit.com"
    },
    "maxFlows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Requests to keep",
      "description": "How many of the latest requests the list keeps.",
      "default": 2000
    },
    "insecureHosts": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hosts with unchecked certificates",
      "description": "Comma-separated hosts whose own certificate is not checked (dev servers with self-signed ones); *.example.com covers subdomains.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "upstreamProxy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upstream proxy (office, VPN)",
      "description": "An office's or a VPN's proxy every connection to a server goes through: http://[user:password@]host:port (Basic or Windows NTLM sign-in; DOMAIN\\user as DOMAIN%5Cuser), socks5://[user:password@]host:port, or a PAC file as pac+http://[user:password@]host/proxy.pac (the credentials go to the proxies it names). Empty: servers are reached directly.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "upstreamBypass": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hosts that skip the upstream proxy",
      "description": "Comma-separated hosts reached without the upstream proxy (this Mac's own addresses always are); *.example.com covers subdomains.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
